proof_body:
by
  intro n
  have h1 := succ_mul_catalan_eq_centralBinom n
  have h2 : (n + 1) * (2 * n).choose (n + 1) = n * (2 * n).choose n := by
    have := Nat.choose_succ_right_eq (2 * n) n
    rw [mul_comm, this]
    have : 2 * n - n = n := by omega
    rw [this]; ring
  rw [Nat.centralBinom_eq_two_mul_choose] at h1
  have h3 : (n + 1) * (catalan n + (2 * n).choose (n + 1)) = (n + 1) * (2 * n).choose n := by
    rw [mul_add, h1, h2]; ring
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.succ_pos n) h3
target_source: ∀ n : ℕ, catalan n + (2 * n).choose (n + 1) = (2 * n).choose n
